eyebrow: Works for any matrix, square or not
code:
A = U @ Sigma @ V.T

# U: m x m orthogonal
# Sigma: diagonal, singular values ≥ 0
# V: n x n orthogonal
caption: Unlike eigendecomposition, SVD never requires A to be square.
